task.title: Changing the Quay Bridge Operator update channel
task.shortdesc: To receive the latest Red Hat Quay upgrades and features, you can upgrade the Quay Bridge Operator by changing the update channel in the operator subscription.

ul.li: You have installed Red Hat Quay.
You are logged in to OpenShift Container Platform as a cluster administrator.

step.cmd: On the OpenShift Container Platform web console, click Operators → Installed Operators → Quay Bridge Operator.
Under Update channel, click stable-3.15 → Save.
